plugins.name: product-rebuild
plugins.description: Rebuild an existing product end-to-end to learn the full product development lifecycle, on top of sdlc. A gated, agent-orchestrated pipeline: mine a reference product, build a feature matrix, slice milestones, decide architecture via mirror-or-diverge ADRs, lock contracts, then build each slice as sdlc features in parallel, and finish at a verified production-readiness gate.
